## Team Memory

The team has 3 active memories from code review:

- **M-001**: Use retries only in the gateway wrapper. (src/**/*.ts)
- **M-002**: Mention the change in every PR description. (**/*)
- **M-003**: Keep review comments short. Do not paste a whole function into a PR comment.

See `.memory/INDEX.md` for full details.
@.memory/INDEX.md
